amendment-log-pack.name: Amendment Log Pack
amendment-log-pack.description: Build one dated log of every executed amendment against the live contract file.

closing-checklist.name: Closing Checklist
closing-checklist.description: Build a closing completeness pack from the closing index, title folder, lender status, and printed dates.

dates-calendar.name: Dates Calendar
dates-calendar.description: Build a dates calendar from the executed contract and any executed amendments.

disclosure-completeness.name: Disclosure Completeness
disclosure-completeness.description: Check the disclosure folder against their checklist: present, signed, dated, or missing only.

hoa-packet-completeness.name: HOA Packet Completeness
hoa-packet-completeness.description: Index the HOA or condo packet against their checklist and list holes.

inspection-to-repair-amendment-log.name: Inspection to Repair Amendment Log
inspection-to-repair-amendment-log.description: Index inspection PDFs by type and date, then list any executed repair amendment that followed.

missing-docs.name: Missing Docs
missing-docs.description: Compare their TC checklist to the files actually in the folder and name holes.

option-period-pack.name: Option Period Pack
option-period-pack.description: Calendar the option or termination-option window from the executed exhibit and effective-date rule.

wire-fraud-checklist-as-their-process.name: Wire Fraud Checklist as Their Process
wire-fraud-checklist-as-their-process.description: Assemble their written verify-before-wire process. Never send, retype, or store wire instructions.
